scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol palette with rank-encoded node colors, clean search UI with icon, and count badges create a polished, functional tool — held back by large empty lower half and no typographic hierarchy between the title and labels.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout has no quantitative encoding violations — count badges are mathematically correct, node size encodes collapse state categorically (not data magnitude), color correctly maps rank, SVG dimensions are data-driven; minor risk from non-globally-unique key function (name+depth) that could misidentify nodes sharing a name at the same depth across branches.
scores.stress_test_note: No brush/zoom/cross-view dispatch risks and search is properly debounced (200ms), but rapid node clicks or expand-all during the 500ms transition lack explicit .interrupt() calls, risking mid-flight position jumps; the scroll setTimeout also captures stale coordinates if a second update fires before it resolves.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view collapsible tree with progressive disclosure keeps working memory load low — only ~14 nodes visible at initial depth-2 expansion, 6-color rank legend maps cleanly to node circles, and search auto-expands matched paths with scroll-to-fit, so the viewer never has to track more than the current branch; expand-all revealing ~200 nodes could become unwieldy but that's an edge interaction, not the default state.

proposer: Inlined the `toggle` function — it was used only once as a click handler. Saves 5 lines (function definition + comment + blank line).
